name: FCC Universal
description: FCC core reduced to the register/parameter writes with a recovered meaning: two 09:27 SDR-assistant writes (0xffff0048=2 setForceFcc, 0xffff0063=3) and a single c1_regulatory_restriction=0 write that clears the restriction (no 1->0 pulse). Country handling stays in the separate 07:30 write / 07:19 readback flow. The opaque and no-op frames (10:58, 00:00, 00:32, 03:AF, 00:E5, 06:8C) and the sdr_lost_prevent safety flags were removed. The 3 frames run in two rounds.

frames.note: Confirmed 09:27 SDR assistant register write: address 0xffff0048, value 2 (setForceFcc)
09:27 SDR assistant register write: address 0xffff0063, value 3; exact effect is unverified
Confirmed PM hash write: c1_regulatory_restriction=0 on bvision:4/perception_agent, clearing the restriction; the paired value-1 frame was removed so this is no longer a 1->0 pulse
